title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, a reserve-coupled oscillator, and a Swiss lever escapement whose half-tooth release is now constrained by reconstructed pallet/contact geometry.

facts.Current pass: M5d spatial pallet-face travel + tooth/segment clearance + geometry-limited half-tooth release
